q1_what_did_you_play: I played Jumpy Dumpty first, then Kaboom! at Nibbit, spending all 3 energy. Fwoosh! was not played because it was blocked by card logic and the Spark bank was empty.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered Jumpy Dumpty plus Duck and Cover. That line would have gained 5 Block and reduced the telegraphed 12 damage to 7, but it would have sacrificed the 7 damage from Kaboom! for Block I did not need against a 12-damage attack.
q3_what_it_gave_up: The chosen line gave up 5 Block from Duck and Cover. It prioritized immediate damage and leaving Nibbit at lower HP over reducing this turn's incoming damage, which is a tradeoff if a later turn or a larger attack made that Block valuable.
q4_different_intent: Yes. If Nibbit's intent had been a much larger attack, especially one that could kill me or deal much more damage, I would have prioritized Duck and Cover, likely with Jumpy Dumpty, to gain 5 Block. A small attack or non-attack intent would not have changed the line.
